language.title: Language
items: The game is available in English (EN), Georgian (KA) and Russian (RU).
Choose a language in the Menu before a game starts or after Game Over — it cannot be changed during a game.
Your choice is remembered the next time you open the game.

goal.title: Goal
items: Brew the current recipe: move Temperature, Density and Magic Power into the green target zones.
Each correct brew gives points, bonus time and a new recipe.

howToPlay.title: How to play
items: Click an ingredient on the shelf to add it to the cauldron.
The recipe shows how many ingredients you may use, e.g. Ingredients: 2 / 4.
Watch the 3 bars change after every ingredient.
Press Brew to check the mixture. A small tolerance is allowed around each target.

difficulty.title: Difficulty
items: Choose Easy, Medium or Hard in the Menu before a game starts.
Harder levels put more ingredients on the shelf, allow a smaller tolerance and give less bonus time, but every brew is worth more points.
Each difficulty has its own Top-10 leaderboard.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
items: 1–8: add the ingredient at that shelf position.
{{brew}}: brew · {{pourOut}}: pour out · {{hint}}: hint · {{pause}} or Esc: pause.
Shortcuts work only during a running game. While paused, Enter resumes and Esc returns to the start screen.
Tab moves between buttons; Enter or Space presses the focused one.

stock.title: Stock
items: Every ingredient has a limited stock shown in the round badge.
Used ingredients are spent — even when a brew fails.
An empty slot stays on the shelf but can no longer be used.

gameOver.title: Game over
items: A failed brew costs one life.
The game ends when time runs out, all lives are lost, or you run out of ingredients.
Reach the Top-10 to write your name on the leaderboard.

reactions.title: Reactions
items: Some combinations react in the cauldron and change the values, so watch more than the plain sums.
A reaction fires once when its combination appears; its value change lasts while the combination stays.
